main_body: A straw bed: a large straw mattress slab (rows ~4-23) with a pillow at the top, and a wooden footboard/front panel with two legs at rows ~23-30.
top_band: The straw mattress (yellow, rows ~4-22) is a large flat surface seen from above with a pillow, with no separate top band and front step. The only front below it is a short wooden footboard.
evidence: The mattress fills most of the object as a flat top-down slab with a pillow drawn at the head, as if seen from directly above. It is not a foreshortened top band. The wooden front below (rows ~23-30) is a short, flat footboard with posts. It is a thin panel with no front-edge highlight line or eave shadow, and there is no recess. The read is a top-down plan with a small front added. It does not match the guide's 3/4 construction, where a short top sits above a taller front face. Fail.

style.evidence: The straw has a few tones (light yellow, mid, dark flecks) and a brown-gold border that is a dark material tone rather than black. The straw texture is sparse, with scattered dark dots and light patches. The wooden footboard is nearly flat, with only 2-3 browns and little grain. Compared with the stall and well references, which have 5-6 steps per material and dense detail, it is thinner and less shaded, with a plain footboard and few tonal steps on the wood.
